P0 — RESTORE GITHUB ACTIONS AND START AUTONOMOUS 24/7

OBJECTIVE

Restore GitHub Actions execution immediately, reconcile the canonical repository checkout, and start the IVX Autonomous stabilization loop.

Do not add new product features.
Do not deploy production until CI is restored and verified.
Do not return another general narrative.

==================================================
STEP 1 — DIAGNOSE GITHUB ACTIONS EXECUTION BLOCKER
==================================================

The last required workflow runs failed before reaching a runner:

- no runner name
- no executed steps
- duration only 2–9 seconds
- empty job execution

Determine the exact cause:

- GitHub billing or spending limit
- account restriction
- Actions disabled
- organization policy
- repository Actions permissions
- unavailable runner group
- workflow concurrency restriction
- invalid environment protection
- GitHub service incident
- other verified cause

Return:

- exact blocker
- GitHub setting or account page involved
- evidence
- whether Rork can repair it
- exact owner action if required

Do not classify this as an application-code failure.

==================================================
STEP 2 — RESTORE ACTIONS AVAILABILITY
==================================================

Verify:

- GitHub Actions enabled for the repository
- read/write workflow permissions enabled
- approved actions policy permits required actions
- GitHub-hosted runners available
- billing/spending limit permits execution
- no account restriction blocks runners
- repository secrets and environments are accessible
- concurrency does not cancel all jobs

Trigger one minimal runner heartbeat workflow:

- ubuntu-latest
- print runner OS
- print repository and branch
- no secrets
- no deployment
- no application mutation

Required result:

RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PASS

Return:

- workflow name
- run ID
- runner name
- start time
- completion time
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
STEP 3 — RECONCILE CANONICAL CHECKOUT
==================================================

Do not use the local branch that is 72 commits divergent.

Create a fresh clean clone from:

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Branch:
main

Verify:

- clean working tree
- zero gitlinks
- zero submodules
- no local-only commits
- no hidden source patches
- HEAD equals remote main SHA

Archive the divergent local checkout for evidence only.

Do not merge it wholesale.

Return:

- remote main SHA
- fresh-clone HEAD
- tracked file count
- archive location
- unresolved file differences, if any

==================================================
STEP 4 — RUN THE REQUIRED CI MATRIX
==================================================

After the heartbeat passes, trigger fresh runs from the same main SHA:

1. IVX CI
2. IVX QA Suite
3. IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
4. Android Emulator QA
5. iOS Simulator QA

For every workflow return:

- workflow name
- run ID
- source SHA
- runner
- status
- first failed step, if any
- exact error
- root cause
- corrective action

Fix code-related failures in isolated branches and PRs.

Do not modify main directly.

==================================================
STEP 5 — REQUIRE THREE CONSECUTIVE PASSES
==================================================

For each of the five required workflows, obtain three consecutive PASS runs from the same verified code line.

Do not certify stability after one pass.

Required result:

- 5 workflows
- 3 consecutive PASS runs each
- all tied to verified GitHub SHAs
- no skipped critical jobs
- no hidden manual bypass

==================================================
STEP 6 — START AUTONOMOUS STABILIZATION LOOP
==================================================

After CI execution is restored, start Autonomous continuously.

Allowed without owner approval:

- repository inspection
- code cleanup
- TypeScript fixes
- lint fixes
- broken import fixes
- regression tests
- workflow repairs
- test isolation
- performance improvements
- safe chat stability fixes
- branch creation
- commits
- pushes
- pull requests
- CI monitoring

Owner approval required before:

- production deployment
- database migration
- RLS change
- authentication change
- payment change
- secret rotation
- destructive data action
- Android/iOS production signing
- AWS, DNS, Render, or Supabase infrastructure changes

==================================================
STEP 7 — AUTONOMOUS WORK ORDER
==================================================

Execute in this order:

1. CI runner reliability
2. CI failures
3. production stability
4. owner authentication
5. data integrity
6. mobile crashes
7. IVX IA chat stability
8. registration
9. reels/media
10. performance
11. security
12. test coverage
13. architecture cleanup
14. dead/duplicate code removal
15. documentation
16. technical debt
17. new features last

One issue per branch and PR.

==================================================
STEP 8 — TRUTHFUL COMPLETION GATE
==================================================

Never mark a task VERIFIED because code or a commit exists.

VERIFIED requires:

- branch
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- PR
- CI PASS
- merge SHA
- deployment ID when deployment applies
- /health HTTP 200
- /version HTTP 200
- SHA parity
- production smoke test
- timestamp

If any item is missing, use:

- FAILED
- BLOCKED_OWNER_ACTION
- CODE_COMPLETE_NOT_DEPLOYED
- DEPLOYED_NOT_VERIFIED

==================================================
STEP 9 — REPORTING
==================================================

Post inside IVX IA Chat:

Every two hours:

- completed tasks
- active task
- PRs opened
- CI results
- failures
- current GitHub SHA
- current Render SHA
- runtime SHA
- owner approvals required
- next three priorities

Executive reports:

- 7:00 AM
- 7:00 PM

Notify immediately only for:

- production outage
- security incident
- data-loss risk
- failed deployment
- failed rollback
- missing credential
- owner approval required

==================================================
FINAL RESULT
==================================================

Return exactly one:

AUTONOMOUS_ACTIVE_VERIFIED

or

AUTONOMOUS_BLOCKED

AUTONOMOUS_ACTIVE_VERIFIED requires:

- runner heartbeat PASS
- clean main checkout verified
- required workflows executing normally
- Autonomous queue active
- first safe task branch created
- job ID
- branch
- commit or current execution state
- next report time

If blocked, state the single exact blocker and exact owner action.

START NOW WITH STEP 1.
